description: Paid ($0.01 USDC via x402 on Base or Solana): call this before your agent buys, holds or accepts a token. Send the chain (solana, base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc) and the token address or mint; get back green/orange/red, a grade (SAFE, CAUTION, RISKY, AVOID), reason codes (mint or freeze authority still active, honeypot, tax or transfer fee, LP not locked, low liquidity, new token, concentrated holders, rugged), a one-line summary, and market data (price, liquidity, market cap, 24h volume, age). Same as GET /v1/token. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.
